_comment: Copy this file to config/company_profile.json and fill in your office
details. It drives the letterhead and the signature block of the generated
SIA compliance report PDF. Nothing here is invented by the software: any
field left empty is printed as 'not specified'.
logo_path may be absolute or relative to the repository root and must be a
PNG (greyscale or RGB, non-interlaced, no alpha) or a JPEG.
